Name: Rory NPC Expanded - A friend for Ariah (Ridgeside)
Author: arcadiabays
Description:
Every time I play with Ridgeside Village installed, I'm upset for Ariah. I feel like she needs a break. So... enter Rory! Rory lives with the Amethynes and befriends Ariah, helping her stand up for herself and convince Maive she needs time to relax, at least sometimes. Rory themself is struggling with their new environment and their relationship with their parents. 

Features:
[list]
[*]seasonal outfits[/*]
[*]two animations![/*]
[*]a full schedule that changes to reflect heart events[/*]
[*]edits to Ariah's events[/*]
[*]edits to Ariah's schedule to reflect heart events[/*]
[*]unique, custom dialogue[/*]
[*]custom map edits to Ariah's room to accommodate for Rory[/*]
[*]changes to Ariah and Rory's room to reflect heart events[/*]
[/list]"Have I seen this mod before?"
Yes! I posted the original, incomplete Rory mod back in 2025, and silvermoonchan picked up the project and posted their own version earlier this year. You can access their Rory [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/47414]here[/url]! Our versions are not compatible, so choose one or the other (both are great!)

"What's different about this mod versus the current Rory NPC mod?"
This mod has fully custom, hand-drawn (by me!) portraits and new sprites to match. I added around 70+ new lines of dialogue, with randomized dialogue for every day at heart levels 10, 6, and 0, and tons of other dialogue for specific locations and days. I've also edited silvermoonchan's Rory events to be more in line with my original vision. Rory also has new late-game content - movie tastes and can attend the resort. Rory also now has an actual bed and furniture and decor instead of just kind of sleeping in Ariah's bed!
ALSO I used i18n this time, so translations are possible! I think. Let me know if I missed anything. 

"What is Rory's identity?"
Rory is a mixed-race nonbinary teenager. They use they/them pronouns, wear a binder, and want top surgery. They're also thinking about pursuing HRT in the future. (Some dialogue refers/alludes to medical transition, so wanted to explain fully here!) They're about Ariah's age. Rory is meant to be sapphic, but doesn't specify this in game. Rory is designed to be half-Chinese-Mauritian, half-white. Their mom is designed to be a Chinese woman from the island of Mauritius - in game, she is referred to as being from "a small island in the Gem Sea, but not part of the Fern Islands." In game, the unspecified island culture is likened to both Ginger Island culture and Ember Island culture (where Pika's from). I believe the Fern Islands are inspired by the Polynesian Islands, some of which are in a similar region to Mauritius. Vaguely. So there's where the comparison in game comes from! My mother is Chinese-Mauritian, and I am half-chinese half-white, like Rory. Various cultural foods are mentioned in Rory's dialogue. 

[b]RORY INFO[/b]
[u]Gift Tastes[/u]
Loves: Strange Doll, Joja Cola, Rainbow Shell, Opal, Tropical Curry, Mango Sticky Rice, Summit Iced Tea (Ridgeside)
Likes: Arrowhead, Ancient Sword, Mango, Green Tea, Ginger Arugula Fried Rice (Ridgeside)
Dislikes: all fish
Hates: Bomb, Caviar, Aged Roe, Wine, Ale, Beer, Hops, Mead, Truffle Oil

[u]Schedule[/u]
Regular and Rain: Amethyne Mansion all day
Tuesdays: Hangs out with Torts in the morning, then back to Mansion in afternoon
Thursdays: Heads to Saloon around noon, then by the mountain lake in the evening
Saturdays and birthday: Heads to the museum around 1 pm, then by the mountain lake in the evening

After Rory/Ariah 3rd joint event:
[spoiler][u]Rory[/u]
Tuesdays: Community Center (if completed) or museum (if not) immediately in the morning, then by the center of Pelican Town in the afternoon, Mansion at night
Fridays: Spends most of the day at the saloon
Saturdays: Morning at the Pelican Town library, then Mansion in the afternoon

[u]Ariah[/u]
Tuesdays: Community Center (if completed) or museum (if not) immediately in the morning, then by the center of Pelican Town in the afternoon, Mansion at night
Fridays: Spends most of the day at the saloon
Saturdays: Morning at the Pelican Town library, then Mansion in the afternoon[/spoiler]
 
[size=4][b]COMPATIBILITY[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Should be compatible with most things, but may have visual conflicts with anything that edits Pelican Town proper or the museum, depending. Let me know if there's any incompatibilities and I may be able to make a quick fix.[/*]
[*]Community Center Reimagined: Rory and Ariah spend time at the community center, and their placement works with both vanilla and Community Center Reimagined.[/*]
[*]SDV Expanded: I don't play with this, so I'm not sure how they show up on any of the modified town maps. If anyone wants compatibility, just let me know what any issues are.[/*]
[*]Sunberry: Compatible. If installed, Rory will stand near the nonbinary stall during Ridgeside Gathering.[/*]
[*]Rory Revived: not compatible. Should pick one or the other![/*]
[/list][size=4][b]PERMISSIONS[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Translations welcome, but no AI use please. Ask about any of the Mauritian foods referred to if needed.[/*]
[*]Ask about any other edits or use! Totally open to portrait and sprite edits or redraws, just ask beforehand! [/*]
[/list][size=4][b]THANKS TO / CREDITS[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Rafseazz for creating Ridgeside Village and for giving me permission to add Rory to their world![/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/silvermoonchan/mods?gameId=1303]Silvermoonchan[/url] for picking up my project and creating Rory's 2 heart, 4 heart, and 6 heart events, which I've kept with minor modifications. They have a ton of mods, so check them out![/*]
[*]Voidwitchcult for their amazing sprite templates! You can support them and get the templates I used [url=https://ko-fi.com/voidwitchcult]here.[/url][/*]
[/list]Please let me know any bugs, issues, missed credits, etc. I was in a hypomanic episode when I made this and the og Rory mod, so my brain space was a little frazzled! This is my first mod (other than the original Rory mod), and I kind of got really into it, but I don't know all the best practices of modding yet. So let me know if there's anything I can do to improve the technical functioning of the mod!

[size=4][b]CONTENT WARNINGS[/b][/size]
This mod deals with transphobia against a nonbinary person and unaccepting parents. There's nothing graphic, but still be aware of the themes of Rory's story!
